description: This file implements the MediaKeys IPC interface for a media application, handling creation, destruction, session management, and event handling for media key sessions via IPC mechanisms. It includes conversion functions for error and key statuses, and manages communication with external media key services.

classes.description: Factory interface for creating MediaKeys IPC instances.
